notes: Scaling Baseline (5 students): 2 students (s-701, s-702) have operator confusion (= vs ==). The other 3 students have non-operator concepts. Evaluates baseline precision and recall in a small group setting.

input.question: Which students are confusing comparison and assignment operators?

grains.text: Uses single = inside if condition check instead of ==
Uses == to assign new value to variable
Understands boolean truth tables and logical AND
